newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal to join humanitarian force for Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to join humanitarian force for Zaire.

text.p: Portugal plans to contribute troops to a multinational intervention force for eastern Zaire, government spokesman Miguel Laranjeira said on Friday.
He told Reuters that the exact number of troops and their departure date had not been finalised, although the contingent was likely to be around 130 men, equal to a company.
The Socialist government decided to join the international relief effort after consulting opposition political parties on Thursday.
At least 10,000 foreign troops are eventually expected to be mobilised to help ease the plight of starving refugees in eastern Zaire.
The initial force would include soldiers from the United States, Canada, Britain, France, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, South Africa and Senegal, diplomats have said.
